rules.logic: BIOC(CL-UNK-1068 IIS Worker w3wp Spawns Command Shell Web Shell CGO) AND (BIOC(CL-UNK-1068 SAM and SYSTEM Registry Hive Save Under Web Shell Causality) OR ABIOC(CL-UNK-1068 python DLL Side Load In Memory Credential Theft Under Web Shell Causality)) AND (BIOC(CL-UNK-1068 certutil Encode Fileless Loot Staging Under Web Shell Causality) OR XQL(CL-UNK-1068 FRP Reverse Tunnel Endpoint Network Egress Stitch)) that share the same agent_hostname and causality_actor_process_instance_id (the w3wp.exe web-shell CGO) within a 1800-second window fuse into ONE incident spanning web-shell code execution, SAM/SYSTEM hive theft, in-memory credential dumping, fileless staging, and the FRP reverse tunnel. The single stitched incident is keyed on the shared causality_id so the endpoint process lineage and the outbound tunnel session are the same causality group, not five independent alerts.
rules.name: CL-UNK-1068 Web Shell to Credential Theft to FRP Tunnel Incident Stitch
